agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers
SELECT AVG(review_score) FROM reviews
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY review_score
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) FROM products
SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT payment_type, AVG(payment_value) FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type
SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS y, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY y
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

SELECT t.product_category_name_english, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT customer_city, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
SELECT AVG(julianday(order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(order_purchase_timestamp)) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN date(order_delivered_customer_date) > date(order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS d FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE WHEN date(o.order_delivered_customer_date) > date(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS status, AVG(r.review_score) FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status
SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
